title: MARK AGENCY / FIELD MANUAL
missingMessage: Your Agency Field Manual contains the general service procedure. If you lost your copy, Alex Murphy can issue a free replacement in Storage. Free one inventory slot if necessary.

chapters.title: Issued equipment
paragraphs: This manual is issued by Alex Murphy in the Storage Room at the start of your first agency assignment.
Reading the manual does not consume it, spend a hint or deduct money, energy or game minutes.
If your copy is lost, discarded or otherwise missing from inventory, return to Storage. Alex will issue a replacement free of charge. You must have room in your inventory.
A replacement is not a new recruitment bonus. Please do not apply for a second first day.

chapters.title: Electronic service panels
paragraphs: Read the serial number. If its final digit is ODD, start with MEM. If its final digit is EVEN, start with TEST. Zero is even.
Perform the intermediate operations specified in the device's own service note. Firmware revisions can change which DIP switch is connected and where RESET belongs.
After those intermediate operations, press whichever of TEST or MEM you did NOT use as the starting button.
Finish with ENTER to execute the selected service operation. Whether that operation releases a door or exports an event log depends on the device.
Do not infer the correct switch from the position of a label. Consult the local service note and observe the actual panel.
The local service note is not a substitute for this manual. This manual is not a substitute for reading the local service note. Legal enjoyed writing that sentence.
